summary: Modulpruefungsordnung Physik L2 of 30.01.2023, section 3: compulsory Physik I to V for Lehramt and the practical semester, one of three 4-ECTS modules (PhL2-7 to PhL2-9), plus 6 additional ECTS from the elective list PhL2-7 to PhL2-17. Only the single module already used for that choice is left out of the 6 ECTS; the other modules from PhL2-7 to PhL2-9 still count, and 4-ECTS modules count only together with further modules until 6 ECTS are reached (one 6-ECTS module is enough).

categories.name: Elective: didactics, modern physics or seminar
categories.note: One 4-ECTS module from PhL2-7 to PhL2-9: Aktuelle Themen aus der Physikdidaktik, Moderne Physik or Physikalisches Seminar.

categories.name: Further physics electives
categories.note: Additional 6 ECTS from PhL2-7 to PhL2-17; the one module already chosen for Wahlpflicht 1 does not count again, but the other modules from PhL2-7 to PhL2-9 do. One 6-ECTS module is enough, and 4-ECTS modules count only together with further modules until 6 ECTS are reached.

po: Lehramt an Haupt- u. Realschulen Physik (2023)
